integrity: The forward implication uses the published FARL consequences FARL17 and FARL18, FARL4, and idempotence of the Gödel product. The reverse implication uses the established monadic Gödel description by a common image subalgebra with lower/upper approximation operators, from which the FARL adjunction and Frobenius identities follow. The finite-chain classification is proved independently by common fixed points and checked exhaustively on small chains and on a non-chain four-element Gödel algebra.
scientific_limitations: The coincidence theorem is restricted to Gödel algebra reducts. The finite formula 2^(n-2) is only for n-element Gödel chains; arbitrary finite Gödel algebras can have more complicated subalgebra structure. No free-algebra size or decision-complexity claim is made.
title: Frobenius-adjoint and monadic expansions coincide on Gödel algebras
